title: How do I make chase scene on RPG Maker MV ?

posts.author: NessCH
posts.body:
I don't know if this question is a FAQ or not ... but I was wondering if any of you guys know how to make a chase
scene on RPG maker MV. (like ones in "IB" or "Ao oni")
any advice would help.
thx :3

posts.author: NoNameWithoutAName
posts.body:
You're in luck! There are plugins specifically for this.
The one I have is Yanfly's
Event Chase Player
plugin. It does exactly what it sounds like! In effect, it looks very similar to Ib's chase scenes. There are other plugins that do the same thing, too! It's a popular mechanic!
The events don't necessarily move intelligently, but if you build your maps knowing that they will be chase scene maps, you can minimize that issue.
You want: open spaces with several ways around obstacles (rows of bookcases with openings on both ends), straight halls without many detours, etc. You don't want: winding halls that run parallel to each other (event might just try to walk through a wall, or backtrack through the hall as the player moves through a parallel hall, etc), cluttered rooms with little corners where the event can get stuck, etc.
